items.subject: Forward a note to Microsoft's photonics team?
items.body:
Hi Edward,

We co-authored a 2015 paper at MIT's Research Laboratory of Electronics, and your published affiliation is Microsoft Discovery & Quantum as of 2026.

Would you be comfortable forwarding the note below to the relevant team at Microsoft? A photonics paper matched to Microsoft, Photonic Ising machines towards and beyond a million spins, was published 2026-11-19. A no is completely fine.

Nicholas

Note you can forward:
Nicholas Harris, founder of Lightmatter, co-authored Deep learning with coherent nanophotonic circuits (2017). Might Microsoft's recent photonics work, such as Photonic Ising machines towards and beyond a million spins (2026), relate to that research?
